items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 8:1
items.html: (To the question) The Mochin that come for the completion of the vessels are discerned as lights of BAN, for the whole correction of the vessels revolves only upon the vessels that already served at the time of the greatness of Nekudim, before their shattering, when they were discerned as vessels of SAG, as is known. And after they came to receive their correction from the Mochin of the new MAH in Atzilut, they received on account of this the name BAN, as is known. Therefore all the lights of MAH that serve only for the correction of the vessels are called only BAN. And there is no MAH in the Partzuf until it is fit to couple by itself and draw, by its own MAN, the stature of MAH; and this is only after the completion of the Partzuf entirely. Thus the aspect of VAK is always called by the name lights of BAN, and even the Mochin of VAK — meaning that they come to raise the AHAP to the Partzuf and complete it with the lower thirds of every Sefira, whereby the HGT become KHB, the NHY become HGT, and new NHY emerge to it, and it is completed in ten vessels, as is known. Therefore, even though the Mochin of VAK are, from their root, an aspect of complete AB, nevertheless they are discerned only as the aspect of 216, and of the aspect of AB of SAG, MAH, BAN, which are the lights of BAN, as is known, for they come only for the completion of the vessels alone, because there is no longer any MAN in the Partzuf from the aspect of the Gadlut to draw Mochin of MAH; this comes only after it no longer needs any correction in its vessels. (Items 64 to 67).
